mentions.name: Nikoli puzzle reimplementations
mentions.description: This project reimplements Nikoli pen-and-paper puzzles (the magazine behind sudoku) to host on a personal blog, working through the maths behind each puzzle and explaining how it contributes to making the games fun to play.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working up reimplementations of Nikoli puzzles to host on my personal blog, the goal is to work through the maths and then explain how it’s relevant or helps create a fun games.
mentions.author: tajd
